text: 货主自行申报的，国内货物可不填货主代码。代理申报参见注①；联络栏同样适用注②。
代办方填写货主代码，不得用代办方代码代替。货主书面证明未获代码的，才由代办方填‘无’。
货主联络栏由联系人本人填写。联络方式为统一窗口的，填窗口站点；仅联络栏留空。
For domestic goods, the principal identifier may be left blank. Brokers may provide their own identifier. For the contact section see note B.
Where a shared office handles contact, enter the office code instead of a person's number.
联系人可允许代办方填写联络栏。统一窗口未启用时，仍由本人填联络方式。
货主没有登记号时请填无，货主未回答时暂留空。请区分经办点和联络方式。
Leave Principal ID blank only if no identifier was issued; the clerk may copy a Principal ID from the principal's signed statement, not from a shipping label.
Retain the explicit declaration of non-registration in the submission record. A blank Principal ID means unanswered.
